artboards.title: TXT Preview — UI original maximizada (paridad exacta)
artboards.notes: Reproduces the original WinForms layout: title bar (always maximized), 52px top bar (Editor/Vista previa/Navegador left, status message center, Configuración + model selector right), 46px Contexto IA bar, dark editor canvas, and the complete 188px bottom deck (3 button rows + slider row) with every legacy control. Palette and geometry from txt.ps1 ($themePalettes, SetBounds).

tradeoff: Exact original UI parity; compact control density at the bottom
alternatives: None — S8 explicitly requires the original UI/UX with no redesign, so no alternative directions were explored.
token_source: txt.ps1 $themePalettes (navy/charcoal dark + light) for this artboard; app/www/css/app.css tokens for design/system.md
